title: Refill Cycle Figures — Urological Supply Program
content:
Urological Supply Program refill cycle figures, identical across all six catheter programs.

| Figure | Meaning | Straight (A4351) | Coudé Tip (A4352) | Closed-System (A4353) | Indwelling Foley (A4338) | All-Silicone (A4344) | Male External (A4349) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply period basis | how a month of supply is measured | rolling from last service date | rolling from last service date | rolling from last service date | rolling from last service date | rolling from last service date | rolling from last service date |
| Months per shipment | most months of supply one shipment may cover | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Refill lead days | most calendar days a refill confirmation may precede the ship date | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| No-earlier days | most calendar days before the covers-through date of the last shipped line that a new line of the same item may ship | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| On-hand check | whether the patient must report the supply on hand nearly exhausted before each shipment | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Government-payer automatic shipment | whether automatic shipments are allowed for Medicare, Medicare Advantage or Medicaid billed patients | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Commercial and self-pay automatic shipment | whether automatic shipments are allowed for commercially billed and self-pay patients | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Missed-cycle backfill | whether units not shipped in an earlier month may be added to a later shipment | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## Points of reference

- A month of supply is measured on a rolling basis from the last service date, for every program.
- One shipment covers at most 3 months of supply, in every program.
- The refill lead figure is 14 calendar days and the no-earlier figure is 10 calendar days, in every program.
- Every program requires the on-hand check, allows no automatic shipment to Medicare, Medicare Advantage or Medicaid billed patients, allows automatic shipment for commercially billed and self-pay patients, and does not allow units missed in an earlier month to be added to a later shipment.
